tasks.name: Restart the Dock
tasks.does: Quits the Dock; macOS starts it again at once. Fixes a stuck or misplaced Dock.

tasks.name: Restart Finder
tasks.does: Quits Finder; macOS starts it again. Open Finder windows close.

tasks.name: Check Homebrew
tasks.does: Runs brew doctor, which only reports problems.

tasks.name: Check npm
tasks.does: Runs npm doctor, which only reports problems.

tasks.name: Flush the DNS cache
tasks.does: Clears cached DNS answers. Rarely makes anything faster; useful after a DNS change.

tasks.name: Rebuild the Spotlight index
tasks.does: Erases the Spotlight index of the startup disk so it is rebuilt. Search is slow and the fans may spin for hours.

tasks.name: Delete system crash reports
tasks.does: Deletes the files inside /Library/Logs/DiagnosticReports. They are crash reports; the deletion cannot be undone.

tasks.name: Delete system-wide caches
tasks.does: Deletes root-owned entries in /Library/Caches (not Apple's own, com.apple.*). Apps rebuild them; it cannot be undone and frees space only for what is there.

tasks.name: Delete old system logs
tasks.does: Deletes log files (.log, .gz) in /private/var/log that are older than 7 days. It cannot be undone.
